name: secure-media-backup
description: Self-hosted & free-cloud secure photo/video backup platform (100% original files, multi-replica, SSE/E2EE)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=apps/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/worker
